name: How much does a resort-style pool typically cost in the Los Angeles area?
description: Costs for resort-style pools in Los Angeles typically range from $150,000 to over $500,000, depending on size, features, and materials.

mainEntity.name: How much does a resort-style pool typically cost in the Los Angeles area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a resort-style pool in the Los Angeles area varies significantly based on size, complexity, materials, and features. A basic high-end pool might start around $150,000, but with custom rockwork, extensive water features, integrated spas, and high-quality finishes, projects can easily range from $250,000 to over $500,000 or more. Factors like site accessibility, grading, and permits also influence the final investment. We provide detailed estimates after an initial design consultation.
